title: Annular substructures in the transition disks around LkCa 15 and J1610
question: Do the transition disks LkCa 15 and J1610 show multiple annular substructures at ~40-60 mas resolution in 1.3 mm continuum, and can planet-disk interaction explain them?

what.value: VLA 7 mm point-source flux of LkCa 15, 16.6±3.6 uJy
Gas surface density profile parameters from 12CO(3-2) of LkCa 15

evidence.quote: We adopt a parameterized initial gas surface density profile based on the analysis of low-resolution $^{12}$CO ($J$=3-2) observations of LkCa 15 by (cite: jin2019)

what.value: N2H+ abundant between 58 and 88 au in LkCa 15

evidence.quote: showing that this ion is particularly abundant between $58^{+6}_{-10}$ and $88^{+6}_{-4}\,$au

recipe.method: CASA calibration, self-cal, concat, tclean multiscale with JvM correction

recipe.goal: Fit axisymmetric Gaussian-ring model to visibilities
recipe.method: Sum of radial Gaussian rings, Fourier transformed and sampled at uv points
Re-center, deproject, average in 9 mas bins using fitted geometry

recipe.goal: Optical depth, dust mass and Sigma_g/Sigma_d
recipe.method: Invert I=B(1-exp(-tau)); Sigma_d=tau/kappa; Toomre Q>2 gives gas upper limit
assumptions: Negligible albedo; temperature from MCRT model or phi=0.02 irradiation formula

recipe.method: Dusty FARGO-ADSG with 60 Earth-mass planet, three cooling prescriptions; RADMC-3D imaging convolved with observed beam
key_parameters: alpha=1e-4; 672x1556 cells; 1000 orbits then 300 with 3e5 particles
assumptions: Gas disk mass 0.1 Msun within 600 au; Rc=65 au

evidence.quote: with a peak intensity of $73.7\pm6.9\,\mu$Jy beam$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Spectral index 1.35-7 mm of LkCa 15 center

evidence.quote: we obtain a spectral index of $0.9\pm0.2$ between 1.35 and 7 mm
we obtain dust masses of 51 and $182\,M_\oplus$ for B47+B69 and B100, respectively
$\Sigma_{\rm g}/\Sigma_{\rm d}<[68,62]$ at their intensity peaks
the cooling parameter $\beta$ at 70 au in the LkCa 15 disk is $\sim0.07 - 4.3$

not_stated_but_needed: Self-calibration solution intervals, number of rounds and reference antennas
Pipeline vs manual calibration and flux model details
Initial uv-fit parameter bounds apart from the sigma constraint
Which calibrator flux values were used
score_reason: Imaging and fitting approach described with key numbers, but self-cal and several clean parameters are missing; hydro part requires specialised codes.
rediscovery_reason: Data likely public after the proprietary period, with numeric ring parameters from a uv fit; moderate recipe completeness.
